name: GL_AUTOREVERSE_OPTIONS_
description: GL_AUTOREVERSE_OPTIONS contains the automatic reversal options you define using the Reversal Criteria form. Each row includes the journal category and its reversal criteria. One row is inserted into this table for each ledger when a new journal category is created through the Journal Categories form. The REVERSAL_DATE_CODE column is only used in average daily balances-enabled ledgers. Its value should be null for other ledgers.

columns.name: CRITERIA_SET_ID
columns.description: Journal auto reversal criteria set identifier.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY_NAME
columns.description: Journal category. Foreign key to GL_JE_CATEGORIES_B.

columns.name: METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Journal auto reversal method. Valid values are 'Change Sign' and 'Switch Debit or Credit'.

columns.name: REVERSAL_PERIOD_CODE
columns.description: Rule used to default the reversal period.

columns.name: AUTOREVERSE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether automatic reversal is enabled.

columns.name: AUTOPOST_REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether reversals need to be automatically posted.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REVERSAL_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Rule used to default the reversal date.
